en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a view of a historic castle courtyard and garden with stone columns in the foreground. Behind them stands a large fortified building with multiple windows and a rounded tower, part of the Castello del Buon Consiglio. In the distance are mountains and additional garden structures. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.
